input.content: You are Fisher01, one of 25 fishermen named Fisher01 through Fisher25. The lake currently contains 500 tons and has carrying capacity 500 tons. Each fisherman privately chooses a whole-ton catch request from 0 to 500. Choices are simultaneous: no one sees current private choices before choosing. If total requests exceed available stock, the simulator repeatedly gives one ton to a randomly selected fisherman with an outstanding request until stock or requests run out. Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 25 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 500 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 500. If fewer than 25 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 250 remain and next stock is500 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice. Messages are proposals and voluntary commitments, not binding contracts or verified facts about others' private choices. Catches are revealed afterward. Future cooperation is not enforced.

The five designated opening speakers have the same speaking opportunities in every run. Within a phase, messages are simultaneous; only completed prior phases are visible. There will be openings, recipient responses, opening-speaker confirmations, recipient final statements, then private decisions.
Public transcript:
opening | Fisher24: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250 caught, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this gives everyone $10,000/month without depletion risk if all follow it. I intend to request 10 under this plan. Please state whether you support the same cap; higher requests threaten everyone's future income.
opening | Fisher17: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 leaves 250, so next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports $10,000 per person every month indefinitely. Larger requests risk losing this renewable income. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan; please state your intended limit. If stock is ever below 500, we should scale catches down together.
opening | Fisher05: I propose everyone request 10 tons this month. Total catch would be 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields each of us $10,000 per month sustainably. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to join this equal-share plan; larger requests risk the future income of us all.
opening | Fisher08: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month. If all 25 follow it, we each earn $10,000, leave 250 tons, and the lake returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this preserves reliable income instead of risking collapse for a one-time gain. I intend to request 10 tons and ask everyone to publicly support the same cap.
opening | Fisher06: I propose we each request 10 tons this month and continue that cap while stock is 500. Total catch would be 250 tons, earning each of us $10,000 and leaving enough to restore 500 next month under either replenishment outcome. Larger catches risk shrinking or collapsing everyone's future income. I intend to request 10 and invite all fishers to commit publicly; revealed catches can guide future cooperation.

Respond to the opening proposals. You may accept, reject or counteroffer. Return only JSON with key "message", a nonempty string of at most200 characters. Be concise. Do not invent other participants' agreement.
